page.content:
Co-creator and visual lead of Avatar.

How Bryan Konietzko connects

  • Topic: Avatar: The Last Airbender — Bryan Konietzko co-created Avatar: The Last Airbender.
  • Series: Avatar: The Last Airbender (series) — Konietzko shaped the original series' world and look.
  • Series: The Legend of Korra — Konietzko co-created The Legend of Korra.

What is Bryan Konietzko?

Bryan Konietzko co-created Avatar, shaping the four nations' look, the bending arts, and the later Korra continuation.

Key threads lead to Avatar: The Last Airbender, Avatar: The Last Airbender (series) and The Legend of Korra.
